wargear.name: Fortification kit
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Spades, sandbag lattices and quick-setting ferrocrete foam, hauled across every battlefield and used on all of them. The unit gains Shrouded (6+), and every model suffers -1 Movement.

wargear.name: Bastion rangefinder
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A tripod-mounted ranging array and a gunner who has never missed a measurement. The unit gains +1 Ballistic Skill, but only when it did not move this turn.

wargear.name: Mechanicum augmetics
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Bionic limbs and subdermal plating, grafted in by the Legion's own sawbones. The model gains +1 Toughness and suffers -1 Initiative.

rules.name: Dug In
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Bastion Doctrine). A unit with this rule that did not move in its last Movement phase counts as being in Cover against Shooting Attacks and may re-roll failed Cool Checks until it moves again.

rules.name: Unbroken Garrison
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Iron Circle Garrison). The Tyrant's guard does not break. While within 12" of Perturabo or a Warsmith, a unit with this rule automatically passes Cool Checks and Pinning Checks, and it may never voluntarily Fall Back.

rules.name: Machine Certainty
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Cold Calculus). The automata feel no dread. A unit with this rule ignores the effects of Fear (X) and cannot be Pinned.

rules.name: Through the Breach
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Breach and Clear). Siege infantry go through the walls rather than around them. An enemy unit charged by a unit with this rule gets no Cover save, and no benefit from a building or fortification, for the rest of that Combat.

rites.name: The Bastion Doctrine
rites.flavor: A line that cannot be turned is worth more than ten that cannot be stopped.
benefits: Iron Havocs, Heavy Support Squads and Tactical Support Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Those units gain Dug In: after a turn in which they did not move, they count as in Cover against Shooting Attacks and may re-roll failed Cool Checks.
limitations: No Antigrav units, no Fast Attack units, and no Recon units other than Tarantula Batteries.
Units with Dug In may not start the battle in Reserves.

modifiers.text: The Bastion Doctrine: Line (1), Dug In.

rites.name: Iron Circle Garrison
rites.flavor: Perturabo trusts no one, and so every wall he builds has a guard on the inside.
benefits: Iron Circle Maniples and Dominator Cohorts may fill Troops slots.
Those units gain Unbroken Garrison: they automatically pass Cool Checks and Pinning Checks while within 12" of Perturabo or a Warsmith.
limitations: Perturabo, a Warsmith or a Warsmith in Artificer armour must lead the army.
Units with Unbroken Garrison may not voluntarily Fall Back.
No Recon, Fast Attack or Heavy Assault units, and at most one Armour unit.

require.note: Perturabo or a Warsmith must lead the army.

rites.name: The Cold Calculus
rites.flavor: A machine does not flinch, and it does not need to be thanked.
benefits: Castellax Battle Maniples may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Castellax gain Machine Certainty: they ignore Fear (X) and cannot be Pinned.
limitations: At least two Castellax Battle Maniples are required.
No Tactical, Despoiler, Assault or Inductii Squads.

modifiers.text: The Cold Calculus: Line (1), Machine Certainty.

require.note: Bring at least two Castellax Battle Maniples.

rites.name: Breach and Clear
rites.flavor: The guns open the wall. Then the armour walks through the hole.
benefits: Tyrant Siege Terminators, Tartaros Terminator Siege Squads, Tartaros Terminator Squads and Veteran Breacher Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1) and Move Through Cover.
Those units gain Through the Breach: enemy units they charge gain no benefit from Cover or fortifications in that Combat.
limitations: At least two of those siege infantry squads are required.
No Armour or Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: Breach and Clear: Line (1), Through the Breach, Move Through Cover.

require.note: Bring at least two siege infantry squads.
